params.name: listingId
params.description: Unique identifier for a listing

items.docs: Retrieves current and historic listings based on the `listingId`.

params.name: listingTypes
params.description: Select the type of listings returned</br>Note: Values are comma separated

params.name: pointType
params.description: Defines the identifier used as a target point

params.name: bathroomsMax
params.description: Maximum number of bathrooms

params.name: bathroomsMin
params.description: Minimum number of bathrooms

params.name: bedroomsMax
params.description: Maximum number of bedrooms

params.name: bedroomsMin
params.description: Minimum number of bedrooms

params.name: carSpacesMax
params.description: Maximum number of car spaces

params.name: carSpacesMin
params.description: Minimum number of car spaces

params.name: landAreaMax
params.description: Maximum size of land space area (measured in m2)

params.name: landAreaMin
params.description: Minimum size of land space area (measured in m2)

params.name: priceMax
params.description: Maximum price of the listing</br>Note: Price definition is set based on the `status` of the listing</br>-  If `status` equals `current`, `leased`, `notSold` or `notLeased` then the price is defined by the `listingPrice`</br>-  If `status` equals `sold` then the price is defined by the `saleValue`

params.name: priceMin
params.description: Minimum price of the listing</br>Note: Price definition is set based on the `status` of the listing</br>-  If `status` equals `current`, `leased` `notSold` or `notLeased` then the price is defined by the `listingPrice`</br>-  If `status` equals `sold` then the price is defined by the `saleValue`

params.name: propertyTypes
params.description: The type of properties that will be queried against</br>Note: Values are comma separated

params.name: status
params.description: Choose the status of the listings returned</br>Note: Values are comma separated</br>Refer to [Listing Statuses](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/guide#listing-status)

params.name: startDate
params.description: Start of date range to be queried. Defaulted to 6 months prior to today's date if left empty</br>Format `YYYY-MM-DD`

params.name: endDate
params.description: End of date range to be queried. Will default to today's date if left empty</br>Format `YYYY-MM-DD`

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of listings results that will be returned for each page</br>Refer to [Pagination](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/pagination)

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius from the target location to search within (measured in metres)

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Defines the sorting attribute and order in which the results will be returned</br>Note: sortBy date logic is set based on the status of the listing</br> - If `status` equals `sold` then the result is sorted by the `saleDate`  </br> - If `status` equals `leased` then the result is sorted by the `leaseDate`</br> - If `status` equals `current`, `notSold` or `notLeased` then the result is sorted by the `firstSeenDate`

params.name: propertyId
params.description:
Unique property identifier used as a target point
Refer to [Obtaining a propertyId](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/guide#obtaining-a-propertyid)
Note: If `pointType` equals `propertyId`, then this field is required

params.name: latitude
params.description:
Latitude used as a target point
Note: If `pointType` equals `latLong`, then this field is required

params.name: longitude
params.description:
Longitude used as a target point
Note: If `pointType` equals `latLong`, then this field is required

params.name: afterPageCursor
params.description: The page starting position as one listing after the defined cursor</br>Note: Cannot be used in conjunction with `beforePageCursor`</br>Refer to [Pagination](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/pagination)

params.name: beforePageCursor
params.description: The page starting position as one listing prior to the defined cursor</br>Note: Cannot be used in conjunction with `afterPageCursor`</br>Refer to [Pagination](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/pagination)

items.docs: Retrieves current and historic listings within a given radius of a target point

params.name: postcodes
params.description:
List of up to 3 postcodes for the listing search area, as a comma-separated list.
The postcodes must be associated with the supplied suburb.

params.name: suburb
params.description: The name of the suburb to search

params.name: state
params.description: The name of the state that the suburb is in

items.docs:
Retrieves current and historic listings within a given suburb.
The suburb search area is identified by a combination of state, suburb name, and up to 3 postcodes.
